newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close off, but CANTV soars.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close off, but CANTV soars.

text.p: Venezuelan telephone company CANTV TDV.CR continued its two-week rise, soaring 70 bolivars to close at an all-time high of 2,161 bolivars, but other Caracas stocks closed off in light trade, brokers said.
"Today's only event in lazy trade was CANTV's rise," said Multinvest broker Mario Simosa, who saw little likelihood of a bounce-back soon for Venezuelan stocks.
The market's 19-share index fell 0.49 percent to end at 6,606.65 points as 17 million shares traded worth 3.4 billion bolivars ($7.2 million), according to preliminary figures from the exchange.
Among traded issues, 21 fell, 14 rose and eight closed flat.
